summary: This is a routine 8-K filing disclosing that the annual meeting of stockholders failed to achieve a quorum, so no business was conducted and the meeting was adjourned. The registrant, Highlands REIT, Inc., reported that only 219,744,634 of 722,202,902 outstanding shares were represented, falling short of the majority required under Maryland law. No votes were cast, and the incumbent directors continue in office. This is a procedural disclosure of a failed quorum, not a special situation event. No deal terms or strategic actions are involved.
